J_P12.mpn: Box header IDC 2x10 2.54 mm, gold (MPN in purchase task)
J_P12.note: Ribbon to P12 (S1 8). Straight box header assumed (P11 parallel to the panel, ribbon to the rear); right-angle variant = question in README. Replaces R1 J4 PANELCORE and J5 PANELSAFE.

R1.note: LOGGER (no P04): FITTED. Full variant (P04 fitted): DNP - P04 R40 is the only PANEL_3V3 source. 1206 0.25 W; short PANEL_3V3-GND: 33 mA / 0.11 W.

J11.mpn: Soldered AWG24 wires (PTFE or PVC 0.25 mm2)
J11.note: Functional wire list in docs/WIAZKI.md. Same contact assignment as R1 J11.1..18.

J8.mpn: Soldered AWG24 wires to TEST port cavities 10/11
J8.note: 1 -> TEST port cavity 10 (LOOP_OUT), 2 -> cavity 11 (MECH_OK). Other TEST cavities do not reach P11 (P11-4/P11-5).

X6.note: 1=center; 2=shell. High impedance 1 Mohm only, no 50R termination. Insulated from a metal panel.

X2.mpn: Amphenol AT04-12PA receptacle (pin contacts per data sheet; purchase task)
X2.note: Panel port L1, key A (P11-2). Only cavities 10/11 of TEST reach P11; all other cavities are wired port -> board directly (docs/PORTY.csv). Cavity numbers, not pin positions.
